snippet.description:
Quadrature in integral calculus explained: learn how to find area under curves using quadrature formulas, step-by-step solved examples, and shortcuts for B.Sc. Maths and calculus exams.

Namaste students! Iss video mein hum Integral Calculus ka ek bohot important topic cover kar rahe hain — Quadrature (Area Under Curves). 

Agar aap B.Sc. Maths, engineering, ya kisi competitive exam ki preparation kar rahe hain, toh curve ka area calculate karna ek essential concept hai. Is lecture mein humne concept ko bilkul base se lekar standard solved problems tak detail mein step-by-step samjhaya hai:

📌 Topics Covered in This Lecture:
• What is Quadrature? (Geometrical meaning & definition)
• Area bounded by Cartesian curves y = f(x) and x = g(y)
• Step-by-step method to setup integration limits
• Important standard examples & past year university questions
• Common mistakes to avoid during area evaluation

00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Rectification
01:16 - Concept of Quadrature (Area Under Curves)
03:00 - Geometric Derivation: Sum of Rectangles to Definite Integral
10:26 - Definition of Quadrature for Plane Curves
11:58 - Area Under Cartesian Curves: y = f(x) (Vertical Strips)
15:28 - Area Under Cartesian Curves: x = f(y) (Horizontal Strips)
18:00 - Prerequisites: Beta/Gamma Functions & Curve Tracing
19:14 - Area Between Two Intersecting Curves
24:18 - Solved Example: Area Between Curve & Its Asymptote
25:03 - Curve Tracing & Symmetry Analysis
26:26 - Finding the Asymptote (x = 0)
30:30 - Sketching the Region & Setting Integration Limits
33:20 - Solving the Integral using Trigonometric Substitution
36:36 - Evaluating the Integral using Gamma Function
39:28 - Conclusion & Next Lecture Preview

Agar aapko kisi bhi step me doubt ho toh comment karke zaroor poochiye. Video ko like karein, share karein aur channel ko subscribe karna na bhulein!

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Intrinsic Equation of Curves | Rectification (Part 3)  → https://youtu.be/l_WXhrJJF0A

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHoWYh3APMj74ok4qgjUFjE71n1qu0P8A

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨
